# Explicit historical addon fixtures

These are byte-identical source fixtures, not production addon modules.
Definitions.lua is the canonical old empty probe queue used by queue codec
regression tests. MatrixSymbol.lua is the BSD-3-Clause historical QR encoder
used by tests/qrfixture and the explicit bridge-input lab. The upstream notice
is retained in its source and both repository notices. See manifest.json for
the fixed source commit, paths and SHA-256. No compatibility adapter exists.
The lab still requires separate authorization for actual game installation/input.
